newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA BCR BANK'S DEPOSIT RATES UP AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA BCR BANK'S DEPOSIT RATES UP AGAIN.

text.p: Romanian state-owned bank Banca Comerciala Romana SA (BCR) will raise interest rates for the third time this year to protect depositors against quicker inflation.
The move follows similar decisions by other Romanian commercial banks after upswings in the central bank's key rates under a tighter monetary policy prompted by rising inflation.
The BCR's rates on individuals' one-month deposits will rise to an annual 110 percent from 60 percent starting on Wednesday, a BCR statement said on Tuesday.

The bank's three-month deposits rates will be up to 111 percent from 61 percent, while the rate on six-month deposits goes up to 112 percent from 62. Nine-month deposits will bear an annual 113 percent, up from 62 percent.
The BCR will pay an annual 115 percent on one-year deposits, up from 63 percent. Sight deposit rates increase to an annual 25 percent from 18 percent, the statement said.
